About.title: About
About.intro: Developer since 2012, in forex since 2015. The story behind Ai X PULSE RS.
story: My name is Alesson Felipe, 36 years old today. I've always been a simple person with big dreams. At 15, I was already renting a place with my wife, who was 16 at the time - just a bed, a mattress, a stove, and a gas canister. I spent seven years working at a beverage warehouse that supplied the beach vendors of Boa Viagem, in Recife. I used to watch the buildings along the shore and the cars driving down the seafront, picturing myself one day moving out of that rental, with a decent car to take my family out in.

It was at that warehouse that I bought my first PC, paying it off little by little. I taught myself computing, downloading guides from the internet - formatting computers, installing Windows, then slideshow discs and CD compilations. I left the warehouse job, went to work as a waiter's assistant, and kept dreaming: one day I'd give my family what I saw successful people doing every day.

I started studying how to make money online - affiliate systems, dropshipping. Affiliates didn't work out, but dropshipping did: I sold my first R$10,000, R$15,000 importing from China. When marketplaces started banning dropshippers in Brazil, I learned to code and built my own online store. Traffic was the problem, so I went after marketing, automated posting in Facebook groups, and ended up with over 100 recurring customers in an affiliate system I built myself - until that also ran into account bans.

At the end of 2015 I discovered binary options. I lost a lot of money at first. I studied it in depth - probability, tops and bottoms, uptrend/downtrend lines, pullbacks - until I became the #1 trader in Brazil and Top 5 in the world on IQ Option, in 2019.

The binary options accounts eventually got banned too, and that's how I ended up in forex. I tried applying the same strategy - it didn't work, so I went back to studying from scratch, this time focused on market structure and automated strategy. Between 2022 and 2023 I lost money chasing miracle robots, buying HFT EAs that promised to turn a little into a lot overnight. I fell for scams more than once.

So I decided to develop my own system. That's when profit started becoming consistent, and that's also when I learned the most important lesson: what blows up an account is not a day without profit, it is a loss without a limit.

In 2026 I combined that lesson with artificial intelligence: the AI Assistant builds the day's plan, Ai X Intelligence tests the plan on each client's own broker history, and each person chooses the risk profile knowing what is at stake, with a defined target and loss limit.

I'm still married to my wife after more than 21 years - she's been through every high and low of this journey with me - and today I'm a father of three. I'm a Christian, and it was my faith that kept me steady through the hardest periods.
If you have fallen for a scam or are tired of easy-money promises, Ai X PULSE RS was built with that in mind: a clear plan, risk you choose and results shown as they are.

Faq.title: FAQ
Faq.intro: What you need to know before starting with Ai X PULSE RS.

items.q: What is Ai X PULSE RS?
items.a: It is our AI trading system that connects to your MetaTrader 4 account. The AI builds the day's plan with you (pairs, target and loss limit) and analyzes the market; order execution on MT4 follows defined rules that you can see and adjust in the portal.

items.q: Is it an AI that predicts the market?
items.a: No. No AI predicts the market. The Ai X PULSE RS AI builds the plan, tests combinations on your broker's history and gives a technical opinion for the day. Trades follow clear entry, exit and risk rules, and results are not guaranteed.
No. The AI Assistant guides you in 5 steps, and the installation guide is in My Account. For any question, I help on Telegram. Experienced traders can fine-tune each pair in the portal.

items.q: Is this an investment fund or account management?
items.a: No. The license runs directly on your own account, at the broker you choose. I don't manage accounts and I have no access to your money: you deposit and withdraw whenever you want.

items.q: How do the risk profiles work?
items.a: You choose a profile in the AI Assistant. The main ones are Conservative (3% daily target, 2% loss limit, 1% risk per entry) and Moderate (5%, 3% and 2%). Custom and other profiles are available in the portal. A higher target means higher risk. Once the target or the limit is reached, the system stops until the next day.

items.q: Does the system use lot recovery?
items.a: Recovery is a per-pair option that you turn on or off in the portal. It raises the lot after a loss to recover faster, and so it also raises the risk. For the most conservative path, keep recovery off and keep the daily loss limit on.

Any broker with MetaTrader 4, any account type, with spread up to 30 pts. If you open an account through my link (or switch the IB code to mine) at a partner broker - FPMarkets, Tickmill, Vantage or Exness - you get $30 off per month on the Monthly License or $50 off the Lifetime License.
Not yet. Today it is MetaTrader 4 only. The MT5 version is coming soon.

items.q: How much do I need to start?
items.a: Recommended capital: from US$500 for gold and from US$100 for currency pairs, on an MT4 account with 1:500 leverage - any account type, with spreads up to 30 points. With less than that, even the broker's minimum lot (0.01) may risk more than your chosen profile allows.

items.q: Do I need to keep my computer on?
items.a: Yes. MT4 must stay open with Ai X PULSE RS running, on your computer or on a VPS (a cloud computer that stays on 24 hours). If MT4 closes, the system stops trading.

MetaTrader 4, any account type, spread up to 30 pts, 1:500 leverage recommended. The system sits on the gold chart (XAU/USD) and trades gold and the pairs you choose (the major forex pairs or other assets from your broker). Portal settings are read every 30 seconds, and accounts send balance and results to the dashboard every 5 minutes. Available in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

Monthly License: $99/month, up to 2 MT4 accounts. Lifetime License: $499 (from $997), one-time payment, up to 5 MT4 accounts. Payment is in USDT or USDC (Binance Pay or wallet).

items.q: How many accounts can I use with the license?
items.a: The Monthly License covers up to 2 of your MT4 accounts, and the Lifetime License up to 5. You enter each account number at purchase; after that, you can change the accounts once in My Account, and further changes only through support. To use it on more accounts, you need another license.

items.q: How do I receive the system after payment?
items.a: As soon as payment is confirmed, you get an email and the license appears in My Account (you sign in with the purchase email, by code, no password). There you download Ai X PULSE RS and follow the MT4 installation guide.

items.q: What happens if the Monthly License expires?
items.a: The system stops opening new trades but keeps managing the ones already open. Renewal is done in My Account and, once payment is confirmed, it resumes on its own within 5 minutes.

guide.title: MT4 installation guide
guide.intro: Follow the steps in order. It takes about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Download the robot
steps.body: On the Downloads page, click Download on the Current version and save the .ex4 file on the computer or VPS where MT4 will run.

steps.title: Put the file in MT4
steps.body: In MT4, go to File > Open Data Folder and open MQL4 > Experts. Paste the .ex4 file there. Then close and reopen MT4: the robot shows up in the Navigator, under Expert Advisors.

steps.title: Allow the license server
steps.body: Go to Tools > Options > Expert Advisors tab. Check "Allow automated trading" and "Allow WebRequest for listed URL", add the address below and click OK. Without this the robot can't check your license.

steps.title: Check your MT4 accounts
steps.body: On the Licenses page you'll find the accounts you entered at checkout. If you left a slot empty, fill it in and click Save accounts. The Monthly License allows up to 2 accounts and the Lifetime up to 5.

steps.title: Open the gold chart on M5
steps.body: Open the XAUUSD chart on the M5 timeframe. Some brokers use another name for gold, like XAUUSDm (Exness Standard) or XAUUSD.r. Use the name shown in your Market Watch.

steps.title: Attach the robot to the chart
steps.body: Drag Ai X PULSE RS from the Navigator onto the chart. On the Common tab, check "Allow live trading" and click OK. Make sure the AutoTrading button on the top bar is on.

steps.title: Accept the terms
steps.body: The first time on each account, a window with the terms of use appears. Click OK. It won't show again on that account, not even when MT4 or the VPS restarts.

steps.title: Check the panel
steps.body: The license status shows at the bottom of the robot's panel. If everything is fine, it shows the license type (and the expiry date, for monthly). Within a few minutes the account shows as Active on the MT4 Accounts page, here in the portal. Below is what each message means.

statuses.meaning: Monthly license active, with its expiry date. All good.
The robot hasn't checked the license yet. It shows right after opening MT4 or while the market is closed, and goes away with the first price move.
This MT4 account isn't registered on any license. Add the number on the Licenses page. The robot unlocks by itself within 5 minutes.
The license expired. Renew it here in the portal: once the payment is confirmed, the robot unlocks by itself within 5 minutes.
The license was blocked. Contact support.
Step 3 is missing: allow the license server address in MT4.
The robot couldn't reach the license server (internet or server down). It tries again every 5 minutes.
No connection right now, but the license was confirmed recently. The robot keeps trading for up to 48 hours while the connection comes back.
More than 48 hours without checking the license. Check your internet and step 3.

tips: To trade 24 hours a day, use a VPS: the robot only works while MT4 is open.
Use an account with a gold spread of up to 30 points.
If the license expires, the robot stays on the chart but stops trading, including managing open orders. It comes back by itself when the license is active again, so renew before it expires.
Need to change an MT4 account? You can change it once on the Licenses page. After that, message me on Telegram.
To see full week and month results on MT4 Accounts, set the Account History tab in MT4 to "All History" (right-click inside the tab).

mesa.title: Analysis Desk
mesa.intro: The RSI only signals that price reached an extreme. Before entering, the robot checks what an experienced trader checks: H4 and H1 trend, support and resistance, confirmation candle, divergence, MACD, session, room to the next zone and the senior trader's (AI) daily bias. Requires robot v7.5.
mesa.rigorHint0: Off: the robot enters on the RSI and filters only (as up to v7.4).
mesa.rigorHint1: Enters with a score of 3 or more (out of 13). More trades.
mesa.rigorHint2: Enters with a score of 5 or more and enough room to the next zone.
mesa.rigorHint3: Enters with a score of 7 or more: few entries, only the most complete ones.
mesa.minRRHint: Room to the next opposing zone, in multiples of the stop. E.g. 1.5x = only enters with at least 1.5 times the risk of free path.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.intro: Always download the version marked as Current. The main button already gives you the robot in your language: panel, settings and alerts.

mesa.biasIntro: The AI, acting as a trader with decades of market experience, reads the D1, H4 and H1 charts of each pair and decides the bias for the next hours. The robot uses it in the Analysis Desk: against the bias it does not enter on that side.
mesa.biasNone: No view for your pairs yet. It arrives when robot v7.5 sends the market summary (every H4 candle).
mesa.biasDisclaimer: Technical chart reading, not investment advice. Markets move fast; the view is refreshed during the day.

mode.title: How do you want to set it up?
mode.autoText: The AI analyzes your broker terminal, picks the best pairs and the best combination for each one and splits your goal between them. Every weekday it runs the analysis again and adjusts by itself.
mode.manualText: You choose the pairs, the goal for each one and the robot settings. The AI shows the chance of hitting the goal and, if you want, swaps a pair's setup for its own.

goal.pairsTitle: Pairs and the goal for each

params.title: Robot settings

analyze.title: Analysis
analyze.text: The robot will read the last month of candles of each pair at your broker and test entry, exit, filter and direction combinations. The AI keeps the ones that also worked in the part of the period that was left out of the choice.
analyze.time: Takes 1 to 3 minutes and runs in your MT4 without disturbing trading. The robot must be running.
analyze.wait: You can keep this page open: it refreshes by itself. If you close it, just come back later.

review.title: Analysis result
review.activeAuto: Active in automatic mode. The AI runs the analysis again every weekday, right after midnight (UTC), and adjusts the pairs by itself.
review.activeManual: Active in manual mode. The robot is going after each pair's goal.

review.disclaimer: Simulation on your broker's candles with real costs (spread and commission), the worst case inside each candle and the recovery. It shows what would have happened; past results do not guarantee future results.
